pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark-brown polygonal patches with slightly rounded vertices and smooth pixel gradients at the margins, occupying the dominant spatial area of the visible flank and neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous topological network of light-colored pathways with uniform pixel thickness, intersecting at clearly defined three-way and four-way junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette formed by short, dark-brown bristly hairs along the upper neck region.
